component.name: Railbench
component.summary: Model railway track planning and layout simulation tool

description.p: Railbench is an intuitive, accurate track planning and layout simulation application supporting major scale models (H0, TT, N, Z, 0, 1, G) with authentic manufacturer geometries, intelligent snap connectors, and real-time electrical traction voltage simulation.

ul.li: Comprehensive library of major track systems: Märklin (C, K, M, 1, Z), Trix, Piko, Roco, Fleischmann, Peco, Kato, Tillig, Kühn, and Bachmann E-Z Track
Precision 2D CAD canvas with zoom (+/-), pan (arrow keys), and full custom keyboard shortcuts mapping
Interactive 3D elevation view with terrain editing, automated mountain tunnels, and 360/180 CAD ViewCube
Real-time electrical voltage drop simulation, catenary overhead wiring, and block section isolators
Layer management, slope gradient calculator, continuous easement ramps, and bill of materials export

screenshot.caption: 2D CAD Track Planning with exact turnout geometry and electrical simulation
Interactive 3D elevation view with terrain, realistic lighting, and CAD ViewCube
Dedicated Terrain and Mountain Editor with automated tunnels and custom layout sketcher

description.p: Release 0.6.1: Real-time automatic ramp generation updates, instant live preview calculation on start point or shape changes, multi-language visual guide in Help dialog, and track context menu refinements.

Release 0.6.0: Full 360/180 3D camera freedom with interactive CAD ViewCube, 2D CAD Sketcher for freeform tables and layer plates, dedicated Terrain & Mountain Editor with sculpting brushes and automatic 3D mountain tunnels, steam locomotive coaling station and diesel fueling station 3D models, Kato Unitrack & Bachmann E-Z Track systems, +/- zoom and arrow key panning, and custom keyboard shortcut mapping.

Release 0.4.0: Märklin C-Track Turntable 74862 (23m DB standard type) & Trix 66862 with 30 exits, 3D Engine Shed environment & scenery model, 3D wood plate sub-structures, H0/N street systems, and point-to-point distance measurement tool.
Release 0.3.0: Continuous ramp generation (Dreisatz & S-curve easement), 2D/3D slope visualizer, left-click marquee box selection, right-click canvas pan, and Trix C-Track catalog.
Release 0.2.0: Multi-platform builds (macOS, Windows, Linux x64/arm64), layer management, voltage simulation, and improved UI.
